name: MsoFilterComparison
description: Specifies how the Column and CompareTo properties are compared for an ODSOFilter object.

constants.name: msoFilterComparisonEqual
constants.description: Column matches CompareTo if the CompareTo value is the same as the Column value.

constants.name: msoFilterComparisonNotEqual
constants.description: Column matches CompareTo if the CompareTo value is not equal to the Column value.

constants.name: msoFilterComparisonLessThan
constants.description: Column matches CompareTo if the Column value is less than the CompareTo value.

constants.name: msoFilterComparisonGreaterThan
constants.description: Column matches CompareTo if the Column value is greater than the CompareTo value.

constants.name: msoFilterComparisonLessThanEqual
constants.description: Column matches CompareTo if the Column value is less than or equal to the CompareTo value.

constants.name: msoFilterComparisonGreaterThanEqual
constants.description: Column matches CompareTo if the Column value is greater than or equal to the CompareTo value.

constants.name: msoFilterComparisonIsBlank
constants.description: Column passes filter if Column is blank.

constants.name: msoFilterComparisonIsNotBlank
constants.description: Column passes filter if Column is blank.

constants.name: msoFilterComparisonContains
constants.description: Column matches CompareTo if any part of the CompareTo string is contained in the Column value.

constants.name: msoFilterComparisonNotContains
constants.description: Column matches CompareTo if any part of the CompareTo string is not contained in the Column value.
